== Summary ==
Identified: [[Alden Peterson]], Josh Eberle. Forum post 28951: "The entire Maple Grove Clan was at TCC ... despite Alden & Josh having been part of our invasion of Madison just the day before"; Alden is Alden Peterson and Josh is Josh Eberle (the only Alden and Josh in the 8 June standings). Five people are shown and the source does not mark which faces are theirs.

== Description ==

The "Maple Grove Clan" at Twin City Comics. At the [[June 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (8 June)]], Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota, 8 June 2003.

== Source and credit ==

Shared by [[Nick Kolnik]] (bluethrawn), who linked this picture as "The entire Maple Grove Clan" in [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=28951#28951 post 28951] in "2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend" (topic 1291), 9 June 2003. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]. The source does not say who took it.

Published on the MNSWCCG "2003 Minnesota SW:CCG Road to States" page, Event Pictures, 06/8, link "Maple Grove Clan!": [http://states.mnswccg.com/road.html states.mnswccg.com/road.html]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040319014922/http://states.mnswccg.com/road.html Internet Archive]
